Article 2 (Areas Incorporated into the Jurisdiction of Yeonsu-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City) The following lots of land in Hakik-dong, Michuhol-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Michuhol-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Yeonsu-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City:

Lots 587-33, 587-169 through 587-171, 587-254, 587-255, 615-36 through 615-38, 615-40 through 615-45, 615-76, 615-77, 618-3, 618-7, 619-7, 619-8, 622-3, 622-6, 622-8, 623-1 through 623-3, 623-5, 623-6, 623-8 through 623-12, 623-25 through 623-29, 623-32 through 623-35, 623-46 through 623-51, 624-1, 624-3, 624-6, 624-9, 624-11, 624-18, 624-19, 624-23 through 624-27, 624-30 through 624-32, 624-40, 625-1 through 625-7, 626-1 through 626-10, 626-12, 626-14 through 626-21, 627-1, 627-4, 628-165, 628-203, 628-204, 628-209, mountain lot 135-19, mountain lot 141-3, mountain lot 142-1, and mountain lots 143-1 through 143-3.
